problem_cards.title: Calls go unanswered
problem_cards.plain_words: The phone rings while everyone is busy and nobody picks up.

problem_cards.title: New customers wait too long
problem_cards.plain_words: People ask for a quote and go elsewhere before I get back to them.

problem_cards.title: Too few reviews
problem_cards.plain_words: Happy customers never leave a review because I forget to ask.

problem_cards.title: Reviews go unanswered
problem_cards.plain_words: I never get around to replying to reviews.

problem_cards.title: Scheduling jobs is a mess
problem_cards.plain_words: Jobs live in my head, on paper and in text messages.

problem_cards.title: Building the staff schedule takes too long
problem_cards.plain_words: Every week I lose hours to shifts and swaps.

problem_cards.title: Getting paid is slow
problem_cards.plain_words: Invoices go out late and I chase people for payment.

problem_cards.title: The books are behind
problem_cards.plain_words: I sort receipts and expenses at the end of the month, if at all.

problem_cards.title: The register does not do enough
problem_cards.plain_words: Orders, payments and reports do not come together in one place.

problem_cards.title: Past customers do not come back
problem_cards.plain_words: I have a customer list and never send it anything.
